summary: Build practical cross-border workforce controls, risk registers, and reporting skills in five days. Explore the advanced training course.
lede: International employment compliance training is for HR, mobility, payroll and legal professionals managing cross-border workforce obligations. It builds practical skills in mapping obligations, assessing workforce risks, reviewing worker classification and payroll controls, governing employment data, and documenting evidence for escalation and reporting.
audienceIntro: This advanced course suits professionals who already manage cross-border workforce activity and need a structured method for testing, documenting, and improving international employment compliance.
modules: Payroll, Tax, and Social Security Controls
prerequisites: Prior experience in international HR, global mobility, employment law, payroll, international tax, HR compliance, internal audit, or workforce operations is expected. You should be able to review employment processes, interpret compliance evidence, and work with spreadsheets or comparable data tables. No programming is required. Advanced digital monitoring and AI-assisted analysis are covered at operational application level, with configuration exercises using templates rather than production deployment.
